proposal.title: Amber's Embrace
proposal.idea: Warm amber fluid contours flow gracefully across the canvas, symbolizing the Holy Spirit's anointing and consecration.
proposal.geometry: Layered fluid currents with rich specular contour ridges, creating a sense of depth and movement.
proposal.typography: Serif-style fonts for the worship lyric band, ensuring readability and legibility.
proposal.imageLogic: Procedural fluid simulation and procedural scene generation, meeting and interacting to create the flowing amber texture.
proposal.texture: Amber fluid with visible specular contour ridges, symbolizing the richness and depth of the anointing.
proposal.motion: Gradual and smooth laminar fluid currents, evoking a sense of reverence and stillness.
proposal.productionMethod: Real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer, using generative image models and procedural code.
proposal.humanTrace: Simulated paper tooth, ink bleed, and film grain, giving the scene a physical and tactile presence.
proposal.risk: Balancing the smooth laminar fluid currents with the need for legibility, ensuring the scene remains gorgeous and slow.

arguesWith.why: The specific disagreement is on the reveal: whether to announce it or not.
